Bidder/Service Provider has to supply the whole quantity as per delivery instr uctions within the stipulated time and at venue mentioned in Bid. Delay in supply will attract LD a sum equivalent to 0.5 (Half) percent of the prices of any portion of stores delivered late, for each week or part thereof of delay as per Ge neral Terms and Conditions of GEM. The calculation will be done for the whole of the week or part thereof. 8. Loading and unloading of material shall be in scope of Seller/Service Provider (including all taxes). 10. Rejection of material: a) If the delivered product/ part of product are not found according to requisite quality/ specifications then the product/part of product will be rejected/confiscat ed/replaced. b) If the Material supplied do not confirm to the specification laid down in the te nder the Department reserves the right to reject the material. The rejected mat erial will be lifting back by the vendor without any extra charge/cost to the Buye r. For the rejected material, no payment will be made and the supply may be co nfiscated/ replaced. c) In addition, in the event of delivery of any defective/sub-standard supply, whi ch owing to urgency or for any other reason cannot be wholly rejected, the Dep artment shall have the power to deduct from any payment due to the supplier s uch amount as penalty subject to maximum penalty of 20%. If required, testing can also be done through Govt. Lab. In case, the material found substandard/de fective, the cost of testing fee will be borne by the supplier firm. 11. Payment of the supplies will be made as per GeM Terms and conditions after necessary material inspection approved by competent authority. 12. After issuing of purchase order to the approved Bidder/Service Provider if he fails to execute the supply order or deny supplying the ordered quantity, in suc h case the Department shall recommend to GeM for debarring such Bidder/Servi ce Providers from participation in the bids at least for one year. In addition if th e approved Bidder/Service Provider accepts the extended bid offer validity after its expiry and fails to execute the purchase order issued to him, it will also be lia ble to be recommended for one year debarment by GeM apart from other actio

n as prescribed in GFR 2017 and other relevant procurement rules issued by Go vernment from time to time. 13. Recyclable material should be used in the product. 14. All disputes and proceedings arising out of or relating to contract/bid shall li e only in Lucknow Jurisdiction. 16.
